source_quote: After a single IV administration, BPC157 was rapidly eliminated from the plasma of rats, and the average elimination half-life (t1/2) was 15.2 min.
route_quote: performed pharmacokinetic studies of BPC157 in rats following a single intravenous (IV) administration of 20 μg/kg
notes: 20 μg/kg IV, n=6; other worklist-source values (IM, repeat dosing, dog) are different arms.
